{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Royal Broadsword Icon.png |caption= A [[Royal Broadsword]] |pronunciation= |plural= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Royal Guard's Series]] * [[Royal Horse Gear]] }} |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Royal Gear|Royal Gear|Series, BotW, AoC}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}}{{Name Ref|TotK, AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Royal Gear was equipment issued to the immediate guard details of the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]],{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Claymore}}
A two-handed sword issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. Its powerful strikes are said to crush an opponent's body and resolve alike.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Halberd}}
This spear was issued to the knights who guarded Hyrule Castle's throne room. Its ornate design was applied by a craftsman in service to the royal family.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Shield}}
A shield issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. It boasts a high defense, but these days it's more a collector's item due to its ornamentation.|Inventory|BotW}} as well as in recognition of impressive martial feats.{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Broadsword}}
The Hyrulean royal family would award this sword to knights who achieved remarkable feats. A sword that balances strength and beauty as elegantly as this one is a rare find.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Bow}}
In the past, the king of Hyrule presented this bow to only the most talented archers in the land. Its combat capabilities are as impressive as its extravagant design.|Inventory|BotW}} Weaponry of the Royal Gear is notable for its combination of power and elegant, elaborate design. The weapons' distinctive ornamentation was created by craftsmen in the royal family's service. Every piece of Royal Gear is metallic. This means they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, but they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. While they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. ====List of Equipment==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Item [Image][Link], Strength, Durability, Description [Transcript] |- | Royal Broadsword | 36 | 36 | The Hyrulean royal family would award this sword to knights who achieved remarkable feats. A sword that balances strength and beauty as elegantly as this one is a rare find. |- | Royal Claymore | 52 | 40 | A two-handed sword issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. Its powerful strikes are said to crush an opponent's body and resolve alike. |- | Royal Halberd | 26 | 50 | This spear was issued to the knights who guarded Hyrule Castle's throne room. Its ornate design was applied by a craftsman in service to the royal family. |- | Royal Bow | 38 | 60 | In the past, the king of Hyrule presented this bow to only the most talented archers in the land. Its combat capabilities are as impressive as its extravagant design. |- | Royal Shield | 55 | 29 | A shield issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. It boasts a high defense, but these days it's more a collector's item due to its ornamentation. }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Like most metal equipment, the [[Gloom]] has caused most Royal Gear [[Item]]s to have significantly reduced [[Durability]], but some uncorrupted Items can be found in the [[Depths]]. All melee [[Weapon]]s from the Royal Gear also gain a new property that increases the damage from [[Flurry Rush]]es. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} ====List of Equipment==== {{Data Table |game= AoC |columns= Item [Image][Link], Min.
